title: Skill Retrieval and Injection
description: Before each batch round, retrieve relevant skills for current task: 1) Build query string from reference description + ticket context. 2) Query ChromaDB for top-K skills. 3) Format as callable function signatures with descriptions and fitness provenance. 4) Inject into build_mesh_system_prompt(). LLM sees available skills and can call them in DSL scripts. Depends on VOYAGE-10 and VOYAGE-11.
definition-of-done: 1. build_mesh_system_prompt() accepts optional skills list. 2. Query ChromaDB with task description for top-K skills. 3. Format skills as function signatures with descriptions. 4. Include fitness provenance in skill descriptions. 5. LLM can call retrieved skills in generated DSL.
testing-plan: 1. Add 5 skills to index, query with 'organic horn', verify correct skills retrieved. 2. Verify formatted prompt includes skill signatures. 3. Verify LLM-generated DSL can call an injected skill.
todos: Format retrieved skills for system prompt
Include fitness provenance in skill descriptions
